journey.name: Search and View Movie Details
journey.description: Tests the search functionality by searching for a specific movie and navigating to its details screen.

actions.action: Wait for the app to load and ensure the home screen is visible.
Tap on the "Search" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify that the search input field is displayed.

Ensure the search bar is focused. If the keyboard is in Chinese mode, find the language switch button (usually a globe icon or "EN" key) on the virtual keyboard and tap it to switch to English. Then, type "Totoro" into the search bar.
Wait for the search results to appear.
Tap on the movie card for "My Neighbor Totoro" in the search results.
Verify that the Movie Detail screen is displayed.
Check if the movie title "My Neighbor Totoro" is visible in the header.
Go back to the search screen.
